_comment: Written by ml/restroom/export_pairs.py from the IOAI data with the code of pipeline.py; equal to the predictions stored in ml/results/restroom/pipeline.json. Gallery numbers are 1-based file numbers. Images under /samples/restrooms/ioai/<split>/ as q<n>.webp and g<n>.webp.
credit: Images: IOAI 2025 Individual Contest, “Restroom Icon Matching”, by the IOAI 2025 committee, CC-BY-4.0 (https://github.com/IOAI-official/IOAI-2025/tree/main/Individual-Contest/Restroom). Resized, otherwise unchanged.
ioaiBaseline: The IOAI baseline notebook as run R0 ran it: zero-shot CLIP ViT-B/16, the second most similar original is the answer (ml/results/restroom/runs/R0.json). Validation and test only; `baseline` is the same rule on ViT-B/32.

val.label: Validation
val.method: global assignment over the whole set (the 30/30 method)

test.label: Test
test.method: global assignment over the whole set (the 30/30 method)
test.hiddenNote: 1 restroom with offensive wording is not shown; it is still in every metric.

train.label: Training
train.method: one query at a time, as the API answers (training restrooms: optimistic)
train.hiddenNote: 2 restrooms are not shown (photos of real people with faces, and nude figures); they are still in every metric.
